mappings.notes: The station is the tracked object: one record per station.

This synthetic message set does not reuse station identifiers. A message set that recycles identifiers needs a field that advances with each lifetime.
The Position message carries no time; the time the datagram arrived is used.
The weather-station message set is synthetic and has no status flags, so every report is marked as test data.
